data.name: Irfaanaht
data.long_meaning: Irfaanaht is a Quranic name derived from the Arabic root 'r-f-n', which means 'to serve'. This name signifies the servant of God or one who is pure and devout. The name is mentioned in the Holy Quran in Surah Al-Qasas (28:68) as a title for Prophet Yusuf (Joseph).
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of one's devotion and servitude to God Almighty.
